newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Bogo-Medellin posts loss in 3 mths to Dec.
newsitem.headline: Bogo-Medellin posts loss in 3 mths to Dec.

text.p: Bogo-Medellin Milling Co Inc posted an unaudited net loss of 15.562 million pesos in the quarter ended December 31, 1996, documents submitted to the Philippine Stock Exchange on Friday showed.
Sales reached 33.106 million pesos during the period, the first quarter of the company's 1996-97 accounting year, while operating costs and expenses amounted to 47.611 million pesos.
Bogo-Medellin is 20.83 percent owned by Jardine Davies Inc .
